hypothesis.statement: On a real 5-minute RR series (Fantasia f1y01), ecgHRVtime reproduces NeuroKit2 hrv_time BIT-FOR-BIT for the three core time-domain metrics (MeanNN, SDNN, RMSSD); pNN50 differs ONLY by a documented denominator convention (ecgHRVtime divides the nn50 count by the number of successive differences N-1, NeuroKit2 by the number of intervals N), with the nn50 count itself identical.

analysis_plan.dataset: Fantasia Database (PhysioNet), record f1y01, a 5-minute RR-interval series (392 intervals, ms)

decision.threshold: descriptive: MeanNN, SDNN and RMSSD equal NeuroKit2 hrv_time to machine precision (max |diff| < 1e-6); pNN50 differs only by the N-1 vs N denominator convention
